title: Right to Examine an Ashgrove CareAssure Policy (Free Look)
content:
Notice of the free-look right — Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance.

The owner may return a new Ashgrove CareAssure policy for a full refund of premium paid. The returned policy must be received no later than the policy delivery date plus the tier's free-look period in calendar days. The free-look end is found by adding the free-look days in calendar days to the policy delivery date; a policy received on that day is in time.

The policy delivery date is the date the owner received the policy, as it stands on the policy record; the free-look end is fixed from it, and the date that counts on return is the date the returned policy was received. A ten-pay policy returned in time from In Force, or a single premium policy returned in time from Paid Up, becomes Cancelled under the free look, and the premium paid is refunded in full.

**Timing (hypothetical delivery; every CareAssure tier allows 30 calendar days)**

| Policy delivered | Free-look end | Returned policy received | In time |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 April 2026 | 15 May 2026 | 15 May 2026 | Yes — received on the free-look end |
| 15 April 2026 | 15 May 2026 | 16 May 2026 | No |
| 20 January 2026 | 19 February 2026 | 12 February 2026 | Yes |

**As conditions and results**

- Condition: the returned policy is received on or before the policy delivery date plus the free-look days. Result: the policy is cancelled under the free look with a full refund of premium paid.
- The refund is of the premium paid in full, whether a single premium or ten-pay installments.
